messages:
sam: Heads-up — incoming enterprise questionnaire from SupplyChain Inc. They want KMS custody proof, RBAC separation docs, and a short incident/vuln timeline. I pasted their asks here: https://example.com/qna (redacted).
maya: Do they need examples for hosted + private?
david: They specifically called out on-prem HSM evidence + audit log snippets for tenant provisioning flows. Also want SIEM ingest sample.
irene: Legal asked we don't include any PII/tenant IDs in the samples — everything must be redacted and have a README explaining redaction.
sec-bot: [automated] new ticket created: SEC-3129 (supplychain-evidence). Assigned: maya, david.
sam: @maya can you assemble a minimal evidence bundle: KMS envelope proof (on-prem + cloud), role binding snapshot, rotation job logs, and a 1-paragraph incident timeline? Keep everything redacted.
maya: I have an on-prem HSM export example. Command we use internally: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/export-keystore --format chain --since 2026-01-01 --mask-ids` — note `--mask-ids` is our redaction helper.
david: For RBAC separation, we can export the role bindings table. Example CSV columns: `principal,role,resource,granted_at,last_modified`. I'll strip principals to team aliases.
irene: Also include proof of monthly service-account rotation. We keep rotation job logs in /var/log/rotation-runner/*. Example log snippet should be fine after redaction.
sam: For SIEM sample, customer asked for fields. Proposed include: `timestamp, event_type, actor, tenant_id(masked), ip, request_id, outcome`. Any objections?
david: That's good. Add `kms_key_id(masked)` and `key_operation` when showing KMS events.
maya: On CVE status: they asked about CVE-2025-1824. We patched on 2026-02-28. Draft timeline: "2026-02-27 internal scan flagged vulnerable component; 2026-02-28 hotfix rolled to prod; 2026-03-01 verification completed; advisory issued to affected customers."
irene: Nice. Legal suggests a 1-sentence risk statement to accompany timeline — I'll draft.
sam: Can someone create a README.md in the bundle that enumerates each file and why it's safe to share? Also include a short pointer to our SIEM schema.
maya: I'll assemble: `evidence_package_5032101112/` contains `kms-envelope-proof.txt` (masked), `rbac-snapshot-2026-02-15.csv` (aliases), `rotation-logs-2026-02-*.log` (redacted), `siem-sample.json` (sample events), `TIMELINE.txt`, and `README.txt`.
david: For the siem-sample, here's an example event we can include (mask tenant): `{"timestamp":"2026-02-28T14:12:03Z","event_type":"kms.encrypt","actor":"svc-model-ingest","tenant_id":"tenant-REDACTED","kms_key_id":"key-REDACTED","key_operation":"Encrypt","request_id":"req-1234","outcome":"SUCCESS"}`
irene: Remember to remove any raw IPs or hostnames. Replace with `IP-REDACTED` and `HOST-REDACTED`.
sam: Great — can we get a preliminary bundle by EOD PST? I'll review and send to the customer's security contact.
maya: On it. Will post link in this thread when ready.
sec-bot: [automated] evidence_package_5032101112.tar.gz uploaded by maya at 2026-03-20T23:18:45Z.
